# Agent Sessions (agent-sessions-tui)

> One terminal view across ten coding agents. Discover, search, and resume local AI coding sessions.

## Overview

Agent Sessions is a focused terminal UI built with Go and Bubble Tea that normalizes local conversation histories from 10 different AI coding agents into a single interactive list.

- **Website**: https://agent-sessions-tui.pages.dev/
- **Repository**: https://github.com/natelindev/agent-sessions-tui
- **License**: MIT
- **Requirements**: Go 1.24+ (or precompiled binary)

## Installation

```bash
# Via Go
go install github.com/natelindev/agent-sessions-tui/cmd/agent-sessions-tui@latest

# From source
git clone https://github.com/natelindev/agent-sessions-tui.git
cd agent-sessions-tui
./scripts/install.sh
```

## Supported Agent Providers

1. **Codex**: Reads `~/.codex/sessions` and `archived_sessions`. Resumes via `codex resume <id>`.
2. **Claude Code**: Reads `~/.claude*/projects` and local transcripts. Resumes via `claude --resume <id>`.
3. **Google Antigravity**: Reads `~/.gemini/antigravity*/brain`. Resumes via `agy --conversation <id>`.
4. **OpenCode**: Reads `~/.local/share/opencode/opencode.db` and legacy JSON. Resumes via `opencode --session <id>`.
5. **Hermes**: Reads `~/.hermes/state.db` and sessions. Resumes via `hermes --resume <id>`.
6. **Copilot CLI**: Reads `~/.copilot/session-state`. Resumes via `copilot --resume=<id>`.
7. **Droid**: Reads `~/.factory/sessions` and projects (Discovery only).
8. **OpenClaw**: Reads `~/.openclaw/agents` (Discovery only).
9. **Cursor Agent**: Reads `~/.cursor/projects/*/agent-transcripts`. Resumes via `cursor agent --resume <id>`.
10. **Pi**: Reads `~/.pi/agent/sessions`. Resumes via `pi --session <path-or-id>`.

## Controls & Usage

- **Move / Navigate**: Arrow keys, `j` / `k`, `Page Up` / `Page Down`.
- **Search**: Press `/` and type. Case-insensitive AND search across provider, ID, title, project, working directory, model, and full transcript terms.
- **Resume**: Press `Enter` or double-click to hand the terminal to the selected provider CLI.
- **Refresh**: Press `r` to rescan local stores.
- **Quit**: Press `q` or `Ctrl+C`.

## Command Line Flags

- `--home PATH`: Read provider stores from a custom home directory.
- `--version`: Print application version.
- `--help`: Display CLI usage and keybindings.
- `NO_COLOR=1`: Disable ANSI colors for accessible or plain terminal output.
